description: Start a job to add a skeleton to one of the user's 3D models with Tripo Rig. Price: 35 Gold. First call chargen_quote_3d_rig, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Spends the quoted Gold; returns request_id to poll with chargen_get_job, which gives the model file (media_url, model_format) when it is done. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

bone_names.description: Bone naming standard, for the engine the model goes to (default tripo).

file_format.description: File type of the result (default glb). Tripo can return FBX even when glb is asked for.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

model_id.description: A 3D model from the user's own gallery: an image_id from chargen_search_gallery with media_type model_3d, or a finished 3D job's image_id.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_3d_rig. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

rig_type.description: Body type of the skeleton (default auto).

name: chargen_edit_3d_rig
title: Rig 3D model
